description: The line plot illustrates the vocabulary size across a number of iterations for three languages: Spanish, Korean, and Japanese, along with an additional diagonal gray line. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Iterations" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Vocabulary Size" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 5000 with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 1000. A solid gray line without markers extends linearly across the plot, starting at a value of 0 at 0 iterations and ending at exactly 5000 at 500 iterations. The Spanish data is represented by a main solid blue line without markers that starts at 0 and increases steadily to approximately 3300 at 500 iterations; it is surrounded by a cluster of fainter, lighter blue lines following a similar trajectory and ending between roughly 3100 and 3500. The Korean data is shown as a main solid orange line without markers, beginning at 0 and rising steadily to roughly 3050 at 500 iterations, accompanied by fainter orange lines that conclude between approximately 2800 and 3100. The Japanese data is depicted by a main solid green line without markers, starting at 0 and steadily climbing to around 3250 at 500 iterations, with corresponding fainter green lines ending in a spread between roughly 3100 and 3300.
